## Turbulence closure: not built {#sec-ch09-turbulence}

### Summary

The directory `src/turbulence/` holds a k-epsilon model and its base class written against Athena++: the source
includes `athena/athena.hpp` and reads its parameters from an Athena++ input file
({{< code src/turbulence/k_epsilon_turbulence.cpp >}}). The library is built from the source directories listed in
`src_files` ({{< code src/CMakeLists.txt >}}), a list that does not include `turbulence/`; no YAML key refers to the
model, and no test builds it. snapy therefore has no turbulence closure: sub-grid transport is the constant isotropic
viscosity and conduction of @sec-ch09-viscosity, optionally shaped in $x_1$ (@sec-ch09-x1profile). The files are not
described further.

### Derivation

No active numerical scheme is derived for this unavailable module.

### Numerical method

No active solver path uses it at the pin, as the source inventory above records.

### Code

The `src_files` build inventory excludes `src/turbulence/`.

### Tests

No test builds this excluded directory.

### Limits

This entry documents unavailable code, not a usable closure.
